Key Insight: This e-commerce market is heavily single-purchase dominated (typical for Brazil's Olist platform). Customers who experienced late deliveries show significantly lower repeat purchase rates. On-time delivery is the #1 lever to improve retention. The ML model has identified high-risk active users for targeted intervention.
